target: gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa snyed la bsnyen bkur dang / mchod pa dang / g.yog bgyis nas sangs rgyas de re re dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de re re la shin tu 'dzem pa dang ngo tsha bas sdig pa'i las kyi sgrib pa dag so sor bshags so/ /
